elements.notes: Footnotes: 1 Includes imports containing more than 99.99% bismuth and other imports. 2 Includes exports containing more than 99.99% bismuth and other exports. 3 Apparent consumption = production + imports - exports + adjustments for Government and industry stock changes. 4 Price is average U.S. producer price. 5 Net import reliance = imports - exports + adjustments for Government and industry stock changes, expressed as a percentage of apparent consumption.
